description: Source code for a scanner utility in the k8s.io/gengo project, implementing token parsing functions such as number, string, and identifier parsing.

classes.name: scanner
classes.description: A struct representing a rune buffer with position tracking for parsing tokens.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next rune in the buffer or EOF if at the end.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns the next rune without advancing the position.

methods.name: peekN
methods.description: Returns the rune at an offset n from the current position.

methods.name: skipWhitespace
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters and returns the next non-whitespace rune.

methods.name: remainder
methods.description: Returns the remaining string from the current position to the end.

methods.name: nextIsTrailingComment
methods.description: Checks if the next non-whitespace character is a comment indicator '#'.

methods.name: nextNumber
methods.description: Parses and returns a number token, supporting various formats including hex, octal, binary, with sign.

methods.name: nextString
methods.description: Parses and returns a quoted string, handling escape sequences.

methods.name: nextIdent
methods.description: Parses and returns an identifier, given a character classification function.
